findings.title: NetworkPolicy blocks the pod's DNS lookups
findings.cause: container web exits because it cannot resolve db: NetworkPolicy egress-db-only restricts its egress and allows nothing to port 53, so no DNS lookup gets out; its log says: "wget: bad address 'db'"; Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container web exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 6 times
last lines of container web's log (run that exited)
NetworkPolicy egress-db-only restricts the pod's egress and allows no traffic to port 53
evidence.command: kubectl get networkpolicy egress-db-only -n kd-networkpolicy-blocks-dns -o jsonpath='{.spec.egress}'

findings.fix: Add an egress rule to egress-db-only (or another policy selecting these pods) that allows UDP and TCP port 53 to the cluster DNS (namespace kube-system, k8s-app: kube-dns).
